filename.description: Contains the name of the new file. Auto-populated from file if not provided

isNewFile.description: If this is a new file being attached

existingJurisdictionAttachmentCode.description: Contains the existing efile attachment jurisdiction. Required if isNewFile set to false

IsPredefinedDescription.description: If this is a new file being attached, use /efile-jurisdiction-attachment-details/{jurisdictionAttachmentCode} endpoint to check if Predefined Description(s) are available or not

IsPredefinedFormElementName.description: If this is a new file being attached, use /efile-jurisdiction-attachment-details/{jurisdictionAttachmentCode} endpoint to check if Form detail and Additional Infos applicable or not

AdditionalInfo1.description: Additional Info 1 for applicable Jurisdiction, use /efile-jurisdiction-attachment-details/{jurisdictionAttachmentCode} endpoint to check if applicable or not

AdditionalInfo2.description: Additional Info 2 for applicable Jurisdiction, use /efile-jurisdiction-attachment-details/{jurisdictionAttachmentCode} endpoint to check if applicable or not

FormName.description: Form name for applicable Jurisdiction, use /efile-jurisdiction-attachment-details/{jurisdictionAttachmentCode} endpoint to check if FormName applicable or not

FormElement.description: Form element for applicable Jurisdiction, use /efile-jurisdiction-attachment-details/{jurisdictionAttachmentCode} endpoint to check if FormElement applicable or not

LastModified.description: Contains the last modified date of the new file being added

file.description: File to be added. Required if isNewFile set to true
